_comment: Curated, portable Arctic Fuse 3 skin settings that define the ThoughtStream look, lifted from the attached build. The setup service applies these on every start (bools via Skin.SetBool / Skin.Reset, strings via Skin.SetString) so the look self-heals and ports cleanly to any device. Deliberately excluded: generator hashes and checksums, the rebuild timestamp, any hardcoded local file paths, background.image (handled by the background copy step), and the HomeSwitcher slot Name/toggle/mode settings (handled by the menu deploy from slots.json). defaultconfig.initdone and home.firstrun are set true so a fresh device does not run the AF3 first-run wizard and clobber this layout. 0.8.6 dropped five keys that no longer exist in AF3 3.4.x (videoinfo.widgets.disabledirector, disablewriter, disablecreator, tmdbhelper.enablecolors, tmdbhelper.enabledesaturate) and turns off the info dialog online artwork gallery row, which fetches a set of remote images every time an info page opens. Search.DisableDiscover sends the Search hub straight to results instead of a Discover / Search / Decades / Keywords selector. Header.DisableWeather false keeps the temperature next to the clock (the weather provider itself is set by the service). Options tile 4 is a custom Add-ons shortcut, and the tile layout is 4 so it shows.
_reset_comment: Skin settings to actively clear on every start (Skin.Reset). The Discover spotlight is a large always-on hero image plus its own widget on the home screen, a big memory cost on a 2 GB stick, so we remove it for the lite profile.
